Plot subduction lines

Source: R/plots.R
subductionlines.Rd

Plot subduction lines

Usage

subductionlines(x, add = TRUE, ...)

Arguments

x

An sf-class object with additional class label of subduction.zones, or plate.boundaries. returned by the online reconstruct method.

add

(logical) By default the plot will be plotting on existing plots. Use add=FALSE to plot from scratch.

...

Arguments passed to the sawteeth function.

Value

The function has no return value.
